exposure: duration of decision to delivery interval (DDI)
time of day (core working hours vs outside core working hours)
cohort: 437 patients at a single, tertiary care hospital
finding: Shorter decision to delivery intervals were associated with worse arterial cord blood pH and base excess, but did not significantly impact the incidence of adverse neonatal outcome.
mod_finding: This study found that a shorter decision-to-delivery interval (DDI) during emergency Cesarean section was associated with worse arterial cord blood pH and base excess, but did not significantly impact the incidence of adverse neonatal outcomes.
